en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
That's fine...but I don't know if I'm any good.

At the orphanage, our chef prepared our meals.
So, I've actually never had to cook until now.

It's been awhile since I gripped a blade
other than a weapon for work.

...I almost forgot that some blades aren't
used for killing people.

...I grew up in an orphanage,
not on the streets.

I don't mind. At the orphanage, we had to
clean and do the laundry by ourselves...

When I do housework, it makes me feel
like a completely normal person...

You're a detective so you must feel like
that too, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Maki looks deep in thought...
